note: Flagship live creep demo. US federal-level scorable actions, March-June 2026, surfaced under the Event-Sourcing Protocol: observable acts only, indicator-matched, status-tagged, symmetry-tested, each sourced across the spectrum. EO 14399 is scored ONCE (chk-06) though it generated many news beats and a second facet (ele-08 ballot barriers) -- per the one-event-tracked rule. CAVEAT: sources were confirmed via search metadata; a human link-check is advised before any publication given political sensitivity. Confidence flags retained from research.

events.title: EO 14399 federalizes election administration & mail-ballot rules
events.actor: President / White House; DHS, SSA, USPS
events.note: Signed 31 Mar 2026: directs DHS/SSA to compile federal 'Confirmed Citizen Lists' and orders USPS to control mail-ballot eligibility -- asserting federal control over election administration reserved to states/Congress. Core sections declared ultra vires and enjoined (D. Mass., June 2026); a second facet (citizenship/ballot barriers) maps to ele-08. Scored once here as the central power-grab.

events.title: ICE defies dozens of binding court orders (Operation Metro Surge)
events.actor: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement / DHS
events.note: Chief U.S. District Judge Patrick Schiltz (D. Minn., a G.W. Bush appointee) found ICE violated dozens of binding orders (96 across ~76 cases by late Feb; later 200+); judges threatened criminal contempt at a 3 Mar 2026 hearing, but noncompliance continued -- detainees kept detained or moved out of state contrary to orders. The violations took effect.

events.title: BIA final removal order against activist Mahmoud Khalil
events.actor: DOJ Board of Immigration Appeals; Secretary of State
events.note: On 9 Apr 2026 the BIA dismissed LPR activist Mahmoud Khalil's appeal and issued a final removal order, holding the Secretary of State's foreign-policy letter 'presumptive and sufficient.' Cannot currently be deported: a D.N.J. injunction holds while his habeas case proceeds. Government also alleged green-card misrepresentation; his lawyers call it speech retaliation. Contested basis -> medium.

events.title: FCC orders early license renewals for 8 ABC/Disney stations
events.note: On 28 Apr 2026 the FCC ordered Disney's eight ABC O&O stations to file license renewals years early (not due until 2028-31), amid content disputes and a DEI probe. The order took effect; ABC/Disney filed 'under protest' 28 May, calling it unconstitutional. FCC says it concerns the DEI investigation, not speech.

events.title: Court finds DOJ prosecution of Abrego Garcia vindictive/selective
events.note: DOJ's human-smuggling case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia -- reopened after he prevailed in a wrongful-deportation suit -- was dismissed 22 May 2026 by U.S. District Judge Waverly Crenshaw as 'vindictive and selective.' DOJ said it would appeal. Included because a court, not the tracker, characterized it as retaliatory; reversed since it was dismissed.

events.title: EPA refuses court order to run $3B environmental-justice grants
events.note: A U.S. District Court (D.S.C.) ruled in mid-June 2026 that EPA's termination of the ~$3B Environmental and Climate Justice Block Grant Program was unlawful and ordered it administered; EPA stated it had no plans to comply, so the defiance was ongoing at the window's close. Coverage skewed center/left -> medium.

events.title: DHS resumes nationwide interior expedited removal without hearings
events.note: DHS's expansion of expedited removal to the U.S. interior (deportation without an immigration-judge hearing) took effect nationwide after the D.C. Circuit (2-1) on 23 Jun 2026 vacated an injunction. Expedited removal is a preexisting statutory tool; the scored action is the interior expansion, challenged on due-process grounds.
